settings.text:
FenderTec specializes in the development of customer-specific rubber profiles. With the knowledge and experience of more than 50 years, we are able to process all kinds of customer-specific requirements in our fender profiles.

Fenders are produced according to drawing and / or model in various rubber qualities (SBR / NR, EPDM). Diameters are possible in D-shape up to a size of 800x800mm and in Cylindrical shape up to a diameter of 2,000mm. Lengths depend on the diameter. Fendertec works with short production and delivery times. Black is produced as standard, but other colors (non-marking) are also possible.

How customer-specific fenders are attached depends on the design and form. Fenders can be produced vulcanized in the radius desired by the customer, so that the fender can easily be fitted around the bow or stern of a ship. Fenders are available in length and the ends can be provided with a beveled side.
